notes.title: A new melee weapon - The force sword for you!
notes.notes:
Today is a great day to acquire great power, the force sword is awaiting the recently released 2.25.406. Key sword facts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/21c1977ef3ac413d2c3393e63a8820f5f155f1ac.png[/img]

1. Two modes: force / frozen
2. To activate, reach out behind your back and press the grab button, you can draw the sword behind your belt too, just make sure your dominant hand goes behind your body vertical plane
3. You need to hold the grab button to keep the sword, once released, the previously selected weapon is instantly selected
4. Damage depends on how strong you strike, up to 100 hit points (full health) for the strongest strike. You do 50% of damage in the "solid" form. Headshots work for sword and still do 200% damage
5. If you hit another player shield while in the "force" mode, your sword is disabled for 1 second
6. A "solid" sword cuts through shields but does less damage
7. You cannot hit other players more often than once every 0.5 sec, enough time for another swing
8. You cannon just when you hold the sword but you can to a strafe jump (right controller stick press) which is a much cooler and faster way to reach your opponent
9. You cannot block the incoming sword with your sword, cannot block incoming projectiles, cannot cut linker, but we will have it in the future!

Let's see if you can handle it:

[previewyoutube=4TV4rCPK898;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Battle Arena VR is live with the Force Field Distortion Shield
notes.notes:
The new BAVR version 2.17.336 is live! With that many projectiles heading towards you and so little time to grapple away, you can now draw the force around you and form a distortion shield. It's a really powerful protection, which you can hold for just about 3 seconds and it needs some time to recharge. It can stop all kinds of projectiles and laser weapons, from SMG and Revolver to Dire Blaster Bolt. Yes, you can stop the Dire Bolt with it and let it drop on the ground without hurting you. Try to catch it though! 

[previewyoutube=bSDZAp5DZBw;full][/previewyoutube]

- The force field distortion shield is new special player ability. Hold the Grab button on your left controller to activate
- Revolver bullet, rocket, and dire bolt projectiles are now affected by the new force field, as well as all other weapons like plasma thrower, railgun, and SMG
- Grapple distance challenge implementation and a new leaderboard for it
- Render only active matches with both players in the game to spectate, track tournament match left events
- Destroy all projectiles on fight start to avoid rockets and dire bolts flying around once a fight is started
- Fix missing sounds on tutorial and playground coordinators
- Fix spawn locations on the titan map
- Stop bot attack on fight start to avoid crashes and lags
- Disable shadows on skin, hands, and all weapons
- SMG and Plasma weapons optimizations for better performance
- Much less sensitive turn around control 
- Disable high five until the cooldown stage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/168822901cef7354eecff9f11d60764803b0e931.png[/img]

- Spatial audio plugin config update
- Update Oculus integration plugin to 27.0.0 
- Register Cosmos controller binding 
- Update Steam VR package 
- Update HTC Vive controller default binding 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/20703253f57860b1139b52b4f6bdd0a016d07106.png[/img]

notes.title: Strafe jumps, horizontal grapple velocity and tournament playground improvements
notes.notes:
In the new release, you can learn the real power of grapple, the updated linker physics allows you to have grapple velocity in all directions including horizontal, and with stronger pull, you will feel like a superhero! And if you want to stay invisible but still move fast, we have added a strafe jump which allows you to add extra acceleration with a well-timed following jump. This update also includes tons of improvements:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/a31b56fba48a46df52f905765a2ffff32e346485.png[/img]

1. Strafe jumps. If you want you to stay low and move fast, this new locomotion is for you, move your head left or right upon landing from the previous jump and hit the jump again to gain extra acceleration, every subsequent jump keeps the extra velocity from the previous so can be really fast!
2. Horizontal velocity grapple. Previously the linker was heavily limited for horizontal acceleration but with the updated physics you have no limits, it feels natural, you swing and fly in all directions and only DBG can stop you.
3. Tournament playground coordinator improvements. With weekly tournaments getting bigger, it's much harder to coordinate matches between participants but with these improvements, there is no need to go to the lobby to find your match. Just stay in the Tournament Playground arena playing with your friends until your match is ready and your opponent is either in the match or with you in the Tournament Playground. 
4. Explosion impulse cancellation fix. Now rocket or DBG explosion impulse is not canceled after a quick delay and will let your target be blown far far away. You can also try it on yourself with rocket or DBG jumps. Try it ;)
5. Loadout skin animation. Now with every skin preview, you see a short performance.
6. Level boundary is no longer damaging you, just bouncing back.
7. Fix for autogenerated names, if you get one (ends with 3 digits), this version restores your platform name automatically.
8. Better reflections on the Janus level.
9. Update hands material, no more rusty hands.
10. Bright tutorial scene, enjoy your first experience with the light above your head.
11. Do not friend dead people, no longer possible, sorry.

notes.title: A new shiny Revolver and smarter bots
notes.notes:
Battle Arena VR v2.13 is live with the new Revolver and smarter bots. What's new:

1. The new gun - Revolver, a powerful starter gun, slower than the SMG, but deadlier and you can score a headshot with it.
2. Rocket launcher is no longer available as a started gun, you need to find it first and you lose it on death.
3. All maps are updated with much more health, armor, some rayguns, and rocket launchers to collect.
4. Bots became smarter and can finally see you properly, they use to "see" from their floor level which in some cases made you invisible for their "eye". Now they can see you properly and can use the SMG or even the Revolver to hit you from the distance. Hide well!
5. A 2-second  respawn protection from being melted by bots, use that time to run/fly away from the respawn location.
6. Instead of announcing when an observer joins, you can now see a number of spectators in your menu. Observers can join only during tournaments.
7. Proper check for got/lost lead status.
8. Performance improvements on repeatable actions for players around you, which makes your frame rate better and your VR experience pleasant!

notes.title: 🛡️🛡️ New level IO and armor to protect you there 🛡️🛡️
notes.notes:
A new foggy map with floating islands will engage your imagination and reflexes to always stay alert on that incoming rocket! You can now pick up an additional armor, make 180 turnaround to instantly respond to the attacker behind your back, and lots of improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/b6ddbd1527d51d5d4df535de90932c16f421d31c.png[/img]

1. New level IO, foggy floating mountains forest with a defense tower in the middle.
2. Shield as additional armor. This is a force shield that you pick up to recharge your shield's energy. The shield scale goes semitransparent on top of the health bar.
3. Snap turn to look back. Make 180 turnaround to instantly respond to the attacker behind your back and lots of improvements.
4. Prevent walking through your enemies. If you happen to run into an enemy, your body will be stopped from moving forward.
5. Better precision for your weapons. There was a precision loss when an enemy is moving fast and rotating in his play area, we addressed it to precisely match a position of the player with a position of the player skin so your hits will be 100% registered.
6. [Steam only] Steam user name wasn't always available. Sometimes, when the connection to Steam is delayed, we can drop the username and generate a random one instead, now we wait until Steam is completely initialized before accessing the platform services like a username.
7. Plasma was OP making bots OP and almost unkillable in close combats. We have reduced the plasma damage by 25% to balance the game.
8. Disable dead body rotation. Whenever a killed person turns in VR, the body used to continue tracking rotation and rotated the dead/dissolving body.
9. [Quest only] Audio was broken on the first load. In specific cases, on the first load after microphone permission request, game audio could become broken. We now request the permission separately, announcing that to a player, to make sure the permission dialog doesn't break audio.
10. Update a few important libraries for networking and VR integrations to improve game performance and stability.
11. Dynamic strength of the linker. Sometimes the linker was too strong when attached on longer distances and too weak when attached too close to a player. We now adjust the strength of the linker based on the attachment point distance to balance and improve swinging physics.
12. Update all maps to include the shield to recharge your armor.

Join our discord to find opponents to play with and share your feedback!
https://discord.gg/BEdWsry

[previewyoutube=ssrPLAqj1p0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Battle Arena VR 2.4.252 Released
notes.notes:
New submachine gun, snap turns, weapons to pick up (and drop), and more! Battle Arena VR got a new public update and it has lots of features based on your valuable feedback. Please continue to provide it because this is what shapes the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/18cd3457968cd28448a6c66eb95bf40e4e74cb3a.png[/img]

**What's New**

1. New weapon - Laser Submachine Gun,  low impact, high precision, very easy to hit a target from any distance but probably not the best weapon to kill it, because of low damage. Great to use it when you need to finish an enemy after 2 railgun/rocket hits.
2. Snap turns support, 45 degrees each direction, use the right thumbstick.
3. Laser aim for the linker! That grapple needs some precision.
4. [Steam Only] Support for HTC Vive and Valve Index devices. We know that snap turns would help not to hang yourself in the play area but without working controllers it was useless. But not any longer.
5. Audio is coming from headphones if connected, no more speakers!
6. Change your weapon with the right controller buttons (next/previous), because the thumbstick is taken by snap turns.
7. Weapon drop from your enemy. If someone steals your gun, now you can take it back, all you need to do... well, you know :)
8. Mute your mic with the left controller Y button, because the right controller buttons are taken by the weapon switch.
9. Railgun is not available by default, you need to pick it up. Every map has at least one spot with this powerful weapon, respawn every 30 seconds.
10. Plasma registers hits with insane precision, which makes it a very powerful weapon in close combat, you still need at least 5 hits (20% each) to kill an enemy, but it's much easier to do now. We have also made plasma flames smaller so you are blinded by incoming plasma beamы.
11. Announce (voiceover) to everyone when a real player joins or leaves the game, very convenient to know when your real opponent is in the game or left you.
12. Fix a visual artifact when a dead player moves to a new location, it used to be visible for a fraction of a second but not any longer.
13. Fix an ability to add bots during team play, when they were not assigned to a team on a non-master host.
14. Disable shadows for your laser aim, it's a laser, it shouldn't have a shadow, right?
15. Fix small level inconsistencies and artifacts.

Join our discord community to connect with other players and the community!
[url=https://discord.gg/BEdWsry]https://discord.gg/BEdWsry[/url]

notes.title: Battle Arena VR is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release![/h1]

Today we are happy to announce that the game is available for everyone to play. And it's FREE! Please, join us in the game to celebrate this event and let us know what do you think. [b]Battle Arena VR[/b] is a multiplayer arena shooter, so don't forget to tell your friends and try this VR experience together. Team up with them or play against them - it's your choice!

[h1]Beta channel for non-Oculus devices[/h1]

Currently, the game officially supports Oculus devices but we also want everyone to try it and prepared for you a [b]beta channel[/b] release which supports [b]Windows Mixed Reality (MWR), HTC Vive, Valve Index[/b]! If you own one of these devices, go to the game properties and switch to a public beta channel, it's already available for download. Let us know if you face any issues installing the beta version.

Enjoy! And happy Thanksgiving!
